instruction:
Two-storey duplex pair from scratch. In Archicad, create a new two-storey duplex pair using real BIM elements for the two building storeys, IfcSpace zones, walls, slabs, roofs, and stairs. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

The IFC must contain exactly two IfcBuildingStorey objects, exactly twelve IfcSpace zones, at least five wall elements, at least two slab elements, at least one roof element, at least two stair elements, and unique IFC GlobalId values for exported root objects. Create two units, A and B. On the lower storey, create A01 A-LIVING 20.0 m2, A02 A-KITCHEN 7.5 m2, A03 A-BATH 5.0 m2, A04 A-STAIR 4.0 m2, B01 B-LIVING 20.0 m2, B02 B-KITCHEN 7.5 m2, B03 B-BATH 5.0 m2, and B04 B-STAIR 4.0 m2. On the upper storey, create A05 A-BED-1 9.6 m2, A06 A-BED-2 6.4 m2, B05 B-BED-1 9.6 m2, and B06 B-BED-2 6.4 m2.

Store each zone number as the zone Reference or LongName where possible. Each listed area must be within +/-0.10 m2, and each duplex unit's total zone area must be between 50.0 and 55.0 m2. The two stairs should read as vertical circulation between lower and upper storeys, but their internal representation may vary by exporter.
